description: Public Speaking builds confidence in front of a group: introducing yourself, a prepared talk with visual aids, speaking impromptu, researching and delivering a longer speech, and running a meeting by the rules of order.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Introducing yourself
requirements.summary: A short talk introducing yourself to a group.

requirements.title: A prepared talk
requirements.summary: A short talk on a topic you choose, using body language and visual aids.

requirements.title: An impromptu talk
requirements.summary: Speaking on a topic you do not know in advance.

requirements.title: A longer speech
requirements.summary: Researching, outlining and delivering a longer speech in a conversational style.

requirements.title: Parliamentary procedure
requirements.summary: Leading a meeting by the rules of order, or answering questions about them.
